usage: The word '兄弟姊妹' refers to siblings, including both brothers and sisters.
You can use '兄弟姊妹' when talking about all your siblings together, no matter their gender.
In a sentence, '兄弟姊妹' often acts as the subject or object when referring to brothers and sisters.
It is a plural term, so it usually doesn't refer to just one sibling.
You can use '兄弟姊妹' in family-related conversations or when describing family relationships.
